name: What factors influence the cost of an accessory suite addition?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of an accessory suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an accessory suite addition is influenced by several factors, including the size and type of the unit (e.g., garage conversion vs. new detached build), the complexity of the design, the quality of materials selected, and site-specific conditions. Utility connections, foundation work, and interior finishes also play a significant role. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to ensure transparency and align the project with your budget, considering all these variables.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include unit size and type, design complexity, material quality, and site conditions like utility connections. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
